summary: Final implementation plan for BlockBallot incorporating EIP-712 typed data signing with OpenZeppelin EIP712/ECDSA, idempotent on-chain reconciliation before ticket reissuance, HMAC-SHA-256 persistent OTP verification, explicit documentation of operator-side identity-to-nullifier correlation limits, contract hardening with non-zero ID validation, duplicate candidate guards, timestamp windows, and comprehensive test suite specifications.
